name: LGF Bookings
upgrade_notice: Occupancy editing (adults/children/babies) now in calendar's Quick Edit Booking modal — click guest name, set values, save.

sections.description: WordPress-native hotel CRM with calendar, bookings, guests, Invoice Ninja integration, and GitHub-based updating.
sections.changelog:
• 1.9.2.97: Occupancy editing (adults/children/babies) moved to the calendar's Quick Edit Booking modal — click a guest name on the calendar, set room occupancy, save. Quick-booking GET endpoint returns adults/children/babies. POST endpoint saves to bookings, booking_rooms, and booking_room_nights tables.
  • 1.9.2.96: Calendar booking popup now shows editable room occupancy fields (adults, children, babies) per room.
  • 1.9.2.95: Rework MotoPress sync room handling — orphan bookings are no longer deleted. They are kept with existing data (guest, dates) and room import is retried non-destructively on every sync. Room mapping errors are clearly logged to Sync Log per booking ID. Original booking headers preserved, never rolled back or deleted.
  • 1.9.2.94: Fix MotoPress sync not creating occupancy — better error diagnostics logged per booking ID in sync log. Added room retry for orphan bookings.
  • 1.9.2.93: Consolidated Settings to 4 tabs (General, Channels, Payments, Data). Room Closures + Tickets are now tabs on Bookings page. Hidden submenu items removed. MotoPress, Booking.com, Invoice Ninja, ICS Export, Sync Log merged under Channels tab. Import + Export merged under Data tab. POST handlers use fallback-to-existing-value to prevent zeroing settings.
  • 1.9.2.92: Fix cancelled bookings still blocking rooms in ICS export — ICS feeds now regenerate when booking status changes to cancelled, removing stale blocked events from the .ics file.
  • 1.9.2.91: Fix Square webhook signature verification — include notification URL in HMAC per Square spec.
  • 1.9.2.90: New Stay Purpose field — track booking categories (pilgrim/hiker, cyclist, work, etc.). Editable list under Stay Purposes submenu. Stay Purpose dropdown on add-booking and booking detail forms. DB bumped to 25.
  • 1.9.2.89: Calendar now shows checked_in and checked_out bookings alongside confirmed.
  • 1.9.2.88: Booking detail form now editable — booking-wide note textarea, room-note input per room. Add-booking: room-note field added. Day-specific notes no longer wiped on booking save. Calendar only shows day-specific notes per cell (no fallback).
  • 1.9.2.87: ICS sync no longer reuses guests by phone+name match — each unique booking gets its own guest.
  • 1.9.2.86: Calendar year navigation — prev/next year arrows keep same month, switch year. AJAX loading supported.
  • 1.9.2.85: Room closures now editable — Edit link in Actions column, form pre-fills dates/reason/room, Cancel returns to blank form.
  • 1.9.2.84: New guest_preferences table + admin UI. Guest lookup (name/email/phone search) on add-booking page auto-fills form. Preferences shown on booking detail page. ICS import no longer pollutes guests.notes. create_wp_crm_booking() accepts optional guest_id to update existing guests.
  • 1.9.2.83: Fix nonce failure causing blank page — replaced check_admin_referer with manual wp_verify_nonce. Date auto-advance wrapped in DOMContentLoaded for reliability.
  • 1.9.2.82: Auto-advance date_to picker after choosing date_from. Darker closed cell bg (#999).
  • 1.9.2.81: Calendar closed cells — room-name row not greyed out, darker grey bg, closure reason shown in guest field.
  • 1.9.2.80: Room Closures page — room selector dropdown for single-room close, bulk delete with checkboxes.
  • 1.9.2.79: Fix room closures table not being created — bumped DB version to 23, added runtime table check in admin page, added database error reporting, closures now included in ICS exports.
